CEG
CEG
Constellation Energy
Added Oct 31
 Net long
Nov 20 expiry
 Power demand from data centers keeps lifting what Constellation's nuclear fleet can earn.
Wrong if: CEG closes below $242.64 (the stop), or the Nov 9 report shows no new data-center contract news and the stock gives back the gap.
What proves it: CEG closes above $270.27 at the Nov 20 expiry.
Why we hold this view: Our view (OPINION): the market still prices Constellation like a regular power company, while data-center buyers are paying up for round-the-clock carbon-free power. The Nov 9 report is part of the idea. We hold through it because new or extended data-center power contracts there are the most likely thing to move the stock toward $290, and the spread caps the loss at $1,026.67 if it disappoints.
